verdict.rationale: Formant's own marketing says users can "ask your fleet what's happening in plain language" and get ML-driven task recommendations that people approve. The analytics docs also mention an AI assistant for building dashboards. The evidence covers natural-language querying and assisted dashboard creation, not operating the product broadly with natural-language commands, and it is thin, marketing-level material. Missing for 10: documented natural-language command execution for device or fleet actions, in-depth docs on the AI assistant's scope and workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask your fleet what's happening in plain language and get governed, ML-driven task recommendations — with people approving what happens next.
Using built-in visualizations, custom SQL queries, or our AI assistant, you can build a rich dashboard for your devices.
